scenario: Create and validate a minimum asset record
preconditions: Synthetic sample loaded; record-entry capability available
test_steps: Enter mandatory fields; save; try a duplicate asset ID; try a missing mandatory field
expected_result: Unique complete record saves; duplicate and incomplete records receive a clear validation error

preconditions: Asset is In Stock; assignment approval exists
test_steps: Record custodian reference, site, assignment date and acknowledgement; save
expected_result: Asset is Assigned and assignment information is recorded

test_steps: Record trigger, accountable owner, due date and follow-up action
expected_result: Asset becomes Return Pending with owner and due date visible

test_steps: Review a due 2026-10-18 asset and a due 2026-10-19 asset
expected_result: Prior-day due is overdue; due-today is not overdue under the documented date-only rule

scenario: Block disposition without required sanitisation evidence
preconditions: Asset requires sanitisation and is Ready for Disposal
test_steps: Try missing result; Failed result; Passed with no evidence; then Passed with evidence
expected_result: Incomplete combinations are blocked; configured transition is permitted only after the required evidence

test_steps: Change lifecycle status and inspect the event history
expected_result: Event includes timestamp, actor/role, old and new state, and reason

preconditions: Dashboard served over HTTP with sample loaded
test_steps: Choose site and status; compare KPIs, charts, review rows and count; reset
expected_result: All components respect combined filters; reset restores full dataset

preconditions: Sample CSV and fixed report date 2026-10-19 are available
test_steps: Compare KPI values with definitions and independent SQL results
expected_result: Counts reconcile; report date, simulation notice and exclusions are visible

preconditions: Dashboard has sample rows satisfying documented queue rules
test_steps: Inspect overdue, missing-custodian, and disposition-control review rows
expected_result: Each flag exposes asset ID, site, status, and review prompt; no flag is called a confirmed incident

scenario: Review data minimisation and access controls
preconditions: Sample file and proposed production access design are available
test_steps: Inspect synthetic data; review role, audit and retention design
expected_result: No direct real personal data in sample; production controls reviewed before release

scenario: Search by asset ID, site, and custodian reference
test_steps: Search a known ID, site, and custodian value with mixed case; clear search
expected_result: Results are case-insensitive and all dashboard components reflect the search

preconditions: Run prototype using a controlled missing file and a malformed CSV in isolated test copy
test_steps: Load each test condition; inspect status, error, KPI area and console
expected_result: Visible error is shown; no stale or success-shaped KPI values are presented

scenario: Use controls by keyboard and inspect no-result state
test_steps: Tab through filters, search and reset; activate controls; select a no-match search; inspect focus and empty state
expected_result: Controls are labelled and keyboard operable with visible focus; no-result state is understandable and page remains usable
